title: prefill-policy-importer-and-quant-consistency-checker
author: Asha Patel
description: Add a lightweight declarative importer for tenant prefill/cost presets and a quantization-consistency linter that flags risky quant profile combinations. Motivation: customers onboard with ad-hoc tenant YAMLs and we see a growing number of subtle cost regressions due to incompatible quant presets + batch/cache defaults. This PR introduces: 1) cmd/cost-importer: CLI that ingests tenant preset bundles (YAML/JSON), normalizes fields, validates against the canonical schema, and emits a safe defaults preview and a dry-run unit-econ report; 2) pkg/econ/importer: Go import pipeline with schema validation, opt-in transformations (batch->microbatch mapping, prefix-cache hints), and telemetry hooks that emit preview metrics to the Console; 3) pkg/econ/quant_linter: Python rule engine (portable rules) that checks quant profile compatibility with model families and sequence-length cohorts and emits lint warnings and suggested fallbacks; 4) CLI preview in pkg/cli that prints a human-readable unit-econ diff and a machine-readable export for the Optimize pipeline; 5) tests + docs + example tenant bundles. Checklist: - schema validation with JSON schema v2020-12 integrated - graceful failure with clear errors and remediation hints - unit and integration tests for importer and linter - telemetry events for preview runs (no PII, sample rate controlled) - docs and quickstart in docs/operations/cost-presets.md How to test: run ./bin/cost-importer --dry-run ./examples/tenant-bundles/* then check generated unit-econ report under /tmp/cost-preview.json and confirm lint warnings include incompatible quant+batch pairs. Also run make test-integration which spins a local dev runtime and validates that preview outputs match golden snapshots. Backwards compatibility: importer only normalizes and suggests; it does not modify live tenant defaults unless --apply is passed. Rollout: behind feature flag enable_cost_importer; staged rollout for 10% tenants then 100%. Linear: ENG-2149 tracks the importer; ENG-2210 tracks the quant linter rule set. Related: this complements the prefilling defaults work and provides a gate to avoid deployment of unsafe quant profiles.
